kept.spine: Goods made here and goods brought in sit on the same stalls, and a stranger is left to tell them apart.
The yards are full of goods bound out, no two lots the same. Selling out of the town is settled work.
The town eats, and food is not a subject anyone here raises unprompted.
The Cartographer's guild keeps its building and its craft, and the supply it works from has stalled.
